messages.text: What’s the actual cost of this?

Right now the only thing you can pay is the $20 early bird deposit. That's it, nothing ships for it, and it comes off the price of the unit when Wave 1 opens. It's fully refundable, and if we don't end up building it, every deposit goes back.

The price of the actual Loto isn't set yet. It's still a prototype, nothing is built, so I can't quote you a number I don't have.

Want the link to the deposit, or shall I flag you when the Wave 1 price lands?

Here's the deposit page if you want it: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/mystery-miner-early-access

No rush either way. If you'd rather mine something you can plug in today, tell me your budget and roughly what you pay per kWh, and I'll point you at the right unit.
